scope: Small bridge to compile/link ONE additional CPU component against an already successful current authoritative gravity CPU Rebuild and its sealed85+1 helper recipe,or run that new component ONCE. Does not Rebuild production,run old main/control/solver/help,modify source or Git,or automatically continue to another action.
parameters: -Mode Build|Run -Kind balance|scales -Configuration DebugCPU|ReleaseCPU -BuildLabel r1 -Label rN -GammaPolicy norm|standard -ExecutionAuthorized. BuildLabel chooses existing main CPU build/helper closure;Label chooses ALL new extra-helper/output/call/check paths. GammaPolicy applies only to scales CLI/oracle,not balance.
input_recipe: logs/upl_gravity_cpu_CFG_BuildLabel.helper.json plus its source_build and actual compile_call/link_call JSON. Require success,configuration/label,85non-main objects and86link objects. Reverify current source/full source snapshots,source/object pairs,original main author SHA,protected canonical GPU6/CPU2,tools,libraries,runtime and successful typed native calls. No attempt to substitute old source as new current closure.
recipe_replay: Use exact old owned compile/link argument arrays. Compiler changes only single source,Fo,Fd,dependency JSON. Linker changes only single helper object,OUT and optional Debug PDB;85 project object paths remain exactly unchanged. Assert source/Fo/Fd/dependency remaps each1,helper/OUT each1,Debug PDB1/Release0,exact sorted85+1 linker set. Preserve all other compiler/FP/CRT/OpenMP/library flags. Use same sealed INCLUDE/LIB/tool environment in memory,not a second setup/program shell.
author_binding: Only selected Kind source/note is read and bound at Build time,plus this new bridge/note and immutable Feedback source/note. balance=tests/support/upl_gravity_balance_r1.cpp;scales=tests/support/upl_gravity_scales_r1.cpp,notes same stem. Scales need not exist when balance is built;no author file falsely assumed completed. New author files are hashbound,not modified or duplicated as framework snapshots.
output_names: upl_gravity_KIND_CFG_Label:outputs stem_helper (newexe/obj/deps/PDB/runtime) andstem_run;logs stem.helper.json,stem_Compile/Link/Component.call.json and.log,stem.run.json,stem.check.json. Fresh-path refusal protects old outputs. Retained binaries/runtime are local evidence only,not a cloud publication claim.
owned_call: Direct native invocation only,with precreated empty log and fresh JSON receipt. LASTEXITCODE is captured immediately and must be Int32;receipt records owned completion/typed exit/invocation failure. No Start-Process,watcher,R alias,cmd-built solver command or retry. Failed compile/link/component leaves sealed receipt/log and existing outputs;postprocessing failure never reruns an already completed component.
gates: Main gravity Debug component from BuildLabel must pass before extras. Release additionally requires main Release and SAME Kind/Label/BuildLabel extra Debug check passed;scales oracle policy must match Debug. Debug/Release actions independent and explicit. Runtime/program/tool/library/source/object/author identities checked before/after;Release does not inherit a failed Debug or old-label result.

run_protocol.balance: --out NEWDIR;completion.json passed/stage upl_gravity_balance_r1,cases4/native_rows72/force_ct_calls4/complete_rate_calls4,conditional implementation/decomposition flags true,continuous residual descriptive,all public/wall/Run/physical/mechanical equilibrium acceptance false
run_protocol.scales: --out NEWDIR --gamma-policy norm|standard;completion.json passed/stage upl_gravity_scales_r1,cases20,gamma_policy matching selected oracle,physical_acceptance false. Detailed numeric/safety scope belongs to selected CPP/note and root offline review,not an invented new driver tolerance.

review_scope: Driver verifies owned exit,immutable inputs/outputs and minimal declared completion schema. It does NOT independently recompute every numeric row or promote continuous balance/stability to physical acceptance. Root may separately audit raw CSV/complete outputs without rerunning finished components.
